siblings.title: Our family. Our jobs.
siblings.subtitle: Different jobs. A shared finish.
siblings.intro: Example: dinner cleanup with siblings at different stages. Choose by practice and readiness, not just age.

rows.label: A small job
rows.detail: Put napkins and spoons on the table.

rows.label: A practiced job
rows.detail: Clear unbreakable dishes to the counter.

rows.label: A longer job
rows.detail: Wipe the cleared table with a damp cloth.
rows.done: Done: crumbs and spills are gone.

siblings.note: Adults keep hot, sharp, heavy or breakable items. Older children do not become the younger child's supervisor.
siblings.fallback: Everyone contributes. Jobs fit what each person has learned. Swap only between people who can do the job safely.

finish-lines.title: Clean means this.
finish-lines.subtitle: A picture guide to knowing when you're done.
finish-lines.intro: Point to one job. Practice it together. Check the finish line.

rows.label: Put toys away
rows.detail: Toys are in their own bins.
rows.done: The floor is clear where you played.

rows.label: Sort the clothes
rows.detail: Dirty clothes are in the hamper.
rows.done: Clean clothes are in a drawer or on a hanger.

rows.label: Clear your place
rows.detail: Your unbreakable plate and cup are at the agreed spot.
rows.done: Your napkin and crumbs are picked up.

rows.label: Make the bed
rows.done: The pillow is back at the head of the bed.

finish-lines.note: Use reachable storage. An adult handles anything hot, sharp, heavy or breakable.
finish-lines.fallback: If the whole list feels big, point to one row. A child who is learning can do it beside an adult.

bedroom.title: My bedroom reset.
bedroom.subtitle: Five small stops. One clear path.
bedroom.intro: Start at the top. Check each stop when it is finished.

rows.label: Trash
rows.detail: Put ordinary paper scraps and wrappers in the bin.
rows.done: Ask an adult about anything sharp, wet or unknown.

rows.label: Laundry
rows.detail: Dirty clothes in the hamper. Clean clothes put away.
rows.done: The chair and floor are not clothes storage.

rows.label: Toys
rows.detail: Toys in bins. Books on the shelf.
rows.done: Keep one unfinished project in its agreed spot.

rows.label: Bed
rows.detail: Pull up the cover. Put the pillow back.
rows.done: There is space to lie down.

rows.label: Floor
rows.detail: Return the last stray items to their homes.
rows.done: The path from the door to the bed is clear.

bedroom.note: This is a tidy-up, not a deep clean. Adults handle cleaning products, high places and unsafe objects.
bedroom.fallback: Put dirty clothes in the hamper. Put toys in bins. Clear the walking path. Stop when the timer ends.

dinner.title: Our dinner team.
dinner.subtitle: One meal. Everyone has a part.
dinner.intro: Pick one job per person. Practice it before expecting independence.

rows.label: Before dinner
rows.done: Done: every place has what it needs.

rows.label: During dinner
rows.detail: Pass a cool, light, unbreakable item when asked.
rows.done: Ask an adult about hot or heavy items.

rows.label: After dinner
rows.detail: Clear unbreakable dishes, then wipe crumbs with a damp cloth.
rows.done: Done: the table is ready for its next use.

dinner.note: An adult handles hot food, sharp tools, raw meat and heavy or breakable items. Match each job to the child's actual skills.
dinner.fallback: Each person clears their own unbreakable place setting. An adult handles food storage and the remaining cleanup.

counter.title: Where does this go?
counter.subtitle: Follow the questions. Give each thing a home.
counter.intro: Pick up one item. Start at question 1. Stop at the first YES.

rows.label: 1. Does it belong somewhere else?
rows.detail: Return it to its actual home, not a second pile.

rows.label: 2. Does someone need to act on it?
rows.detail: Add a next step and date. Use one action spot.

rows.label: 3. Do we need to keep it?
rows.detail: Put it in the labeled place where you will look for it.

rows.label: 4. Is it ready to leave?
rows.detail: Use the right local disposal route. Ask about unknown items.
rows.done: Not sure? Use the temporary tray below.

counter.note: Protect private papers. Keep medicines, sharp items and unknown objects for an adult to handle.
counter.fallback: Clear one useful patch of counter. Stop at the timer. Anything still undecided goes in one temporary tray with an owner and review time.
